title: Idiom debt ledger (NO4)
description: A port rewrite needed only because the compiler handles the idiomatic form badly is compiler debt (architecture §18.3 NO4, plan rule 10). Each entry keeps the idiomatic form as a regression case in this repository and the size the workaround reaches; the compiler owes size(idiomatic) <= size(workaround) under the entry's codec. Validated by scripts/lib/idiom-debt.mjs (node --test scripts/verify-runners.test.mjs).

description.description: The source shape in one line.

files.description: Port files (repository-relative) where the form appears.

commit.description: The port commit that shows the form.

idiomatic.description: What upstream writes and the port would write if the compiler handled it.

case.description: The regression case holding the idiomatic form, in this repository.

binary.description: The compiler (label or SHA-256 prefix) that measured both.

owner.description: The plan task that pays the debt.

paid.description: When status is paid: the commit and sizes that paid it.
